cohort: 108 women who had Caesarean sections were randomly assigned to either a TENS group (n=54) or a control group (n=54).
finding: TENS therapy significantly decreased the occurrence of post-Caesarean wound infections (7.4% vs 22.2% in control), expedited wound healing, enhanced pain control, and increased patient satisfaction.
mod_finding: TENS therapy was shown to effectively reduce wound infections, improve healing, and control pain specifically in women who had undergone a Caesarean section.
